name: Negative feedback
description: Downstream hormone activity suppresses upstream drive, stabilizing output around a regulated range.

name: Positive feedback
description: Under specific physiological conditions, a downstream signal amplifies upstream activity for a limited event.

name: Pulsatile signaling
description: Information is encoded partly in pulse frequency and amplitude, so a single concentration does not capture the whole system.

name: Circadian / ultradian control
description: Hormone output changes predictably with biological time and shorter oscillations, complicating one-time measurements.

name: Distributed metabolic feedback
description: Nutrients, organs and neural inputs form a network rather than a single linear endocrine axis.
